source='''def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in row] for row in grid]
    colors = {c for row in grid for c in row if c != bg}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        old_size = min(r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1)
        size = 9 if old_size == 1 else old_size-2
        r = (r0+r1-size+1)//2
        c = (c0+c1-size+1)//2
        for i in range(size):
            for j in range(size):
                out[r+i][c+j] = color
    return out
'''
